name: South Dakota

flag.description: A sky blue field with the state seal in the centre, surrounded by a serrated gold sunburst, with "SOUTH DAKOTA" arched above and "THE MOUNT RUSHMORE STATE" arched below in gold.
flag.symbolism: The sunburst reflects the state's sunny climate, and the seal shows farming, ranching, mining and river trade under the motto "Under God the People Rule".

hook: South Dakota rings its seal with a spiky gold sun and spells "THE MOUNT RUSHMORE STATE" round the bottom.
trivia: Until 1992 the lower text read "THE SUNSHINE STATE"; it was changed to "THE MOUNT RUSHMORE STATE".
South Dakota and North Dakota were admitted on the same day in 1889; which came first was deliberately obscured.
